resources.string: Send a problem report
Helps the Lumen OS developer find out what went wrong. Nothing is sent until you press Send report.
Included
System version, uptime and system slot
System and Lumen app logs of the last 30 minutes
Crash, freeze and restart records with app names
Kernel log of the last restart and the update log
Screen, memory and network type
Removed or not included
Accounts, e-mail addresses and phone numbers
Wi-Fi names, IP and MAC addresses
Serial number: a random ID of this projector is used instead
Logs of apps you installed yourself
Photos, files and passwords
The report is kept for 30 days. Only the Lumen OS developer can open it.
